description: At Congruent, we build radars for end-to-end autonomous systems. The most advanced autonomous systems are trained as a single neural network from raw sensor data to navigation actions. description: KERYS Software is a Deeptech software publisher whose goal is to help companies reduce their infrastructure costs, exposure to cyber-threats and carbon footprint by rethinking how their employees are equipped. KERYS Software offers a unique solution that allows multiple work environments to be pooled on a single computer in a completely secure manner, without compromising performance. Users and administrators can switch from one operating system to another with a single click, on a single workstation. Kerys Software' innovative microkernel ensures high security through strict isolation between environments, while avoiding the usual overload of virtualisation. KERYS Software's solution can therefore run multiple virtual machines on a single physical host with near-bare-metal performance and robust security, compliant with DORA and NIS2 standards. KERYS Software customers benefit from significant and immediate savings thanks to the reduction of IT equipment used by employees, as well as improved productivity thanks to an easy switch between environments. As a mission-driven company, KERYS Software brings a substantial reduction in corporate carbon footprint by reducing the amount of IT equipment purchased and used, perfectly aligning with stringent ESG policies.

description: One of the most important bets in KP history. When Compaq set out to build the first IBM-compatible portable computer, KP backed the vision and helped recruit the sales leadership that would define the company's go-to-market strategy. In its first full year of operations, Compaq sold 53,000 PCs, generating $111 million in sales, a record at the time in the technology sector, and went public in 1983. KP's involvement didn't stop at the investment: Compaq hit the $1 billion revenue mark in 1987, doing so faster than any other company in history at that point. name: Genentech
description: Genentech isn't just a Kleiner Perkins investment; it's part of our DNA. Genentech was co-founded in 1976 by a young KP partner who had been closely tracking breakthrough research in recombinant DNA technology. Over a beer, the partnership was struck: Kleiner Perkins would provide seed capital, and together they would build an entirely new kind of company. KP didn't just write a check. KP partners joined the board and helped the company pioneer a new way to attract scientific talent, pulling researchers out of academia and into industry for the first time. The model they invented, licensing science to established pharma partners while building a world-class internal R&D engine, became the blueprint for the entire biotech industry. The success of Genentech in the early 1980s established the foundation for the biotech sector to flourish. When Roche acquired full control of the company in 2009, Genentech was valued at $100 billion.

name: Google
description: In 1999, Andy Bechtolsheim introduced us to two Stanford graduates, Larry Page and Sergey Brin. They'd built PageRank, a superior search algorithm that overwhelmed Stanford's network with demand. Banished from campus, they needed capital and scale—fast. Their 17-page deck had just two pages of numbers and three cartoons. As the eighteenth search engine with no business model and no team, they faced long odds. But when John Doerr asked how big Google would be, they answered: "$10 billion in revenue." We wrote our largest check ever. The founders weren't sold on traditional management or recruiting a CEO. John connected them with Scott Cook, Bill Gates, Andy Grove, and Steve Jobs for advice. The executive search led to Eric Schmidt, an experienced tech leader from Sun Microsystems. We helped build their team with Wayne Rosing (VP Engineering) and Jonathan Rosenberg (SVP Product), introduced OKRs for goal-setting, and brought in executive coach Bill Campbell to develop leadership skills. Our investment in Google delivered exceptional returns and transformed how the world accesses information. John continues as a board director of Alphabet, Inc.

name: Intuit
description: When Intuit was founded in 1983, popular understanding of how personal computers could be used was confined to basic word processing and spreadsheets. The founder saw something different: a chance to bring personal finance software to everyday households. Kleiner Perkins backed the company in 1990, and from the start the partnership was an active one. When Microsoft launched a direct competitor to Quicken, KP helped Intuit fight back and win. When it was time to find a new CEO, KP helped develop the candidate list, ultimately landing on a legendary Silicon Valley executive who took the helm in 1994. When Microsoft came back with an acquisition offer, KP was at the table for those negotiations too. The Department of Justice ultimately blocked the deal, and Intuit proceeded as an independent company and went from success to success. Today it is one of the most enduring software businesses ever built, a testament to what happens when a simple insight about everyday life meets the right backing at the right moment.

name: Netscape
description: Before Netscape, the internet existed but most people had no way in. Kleiner Perkins backed Netscape in 1994, betting that a fast, graphical browser could unlock the web for everyday users and spark a new era of commerce and communication. John Doerr joined the board, and in late 1994 the company shipped Netscape Navigator, one of the first browsers that made it genuinely easy to access and navigate the internet. The company's 1995 IPO priced at a $2.9 billion valuation, becoming one of the defining moments of the dot-com era. Netscape marked the beginning of the Internet Age, and while the company no longer exists, its legacy lives on in Mozilla, the open-source project built from Netscape's code. The investment also marked something else: proof that KP could identify not just great companies, but entirely new epochs.

description: In the early 1980s, existing computing technology operated in proprietary, walled gardens. A KP partner joined the board and later took a sabbatical from the firm to work directly with Sun, helping develop the SPARC microprocessor. Sun's growth was explosive, expanding its range of products to include Java, the Solaris operating system, and SPARC, and contributing significantly to Unix, RISC processors, thin client computing, and virtualized computing. description: 디딤센서는 스마트팩토리 구축에 필수적인 검사자동화용 머신비전센서를 개발 및 공급합니다.

name: 디엘피스튜디오
description: 판무림은 4060 중년세대를 위한 웹소설 플랫폼입니다.

name: 딥다이버스
description: 트래킷은 중견기업용 커스텀 CRM으로 영업 데이터를 자동 수집·분석해 매출 예측과 성공 패턴 반복을 지원합니다.

name: 라이언로켓
description: "새로운 차원의 몰입갑으로 일상을 즐겁게" 라이언로켓은 생성 AI 기술 스타트업입니다.

name: 라이프엑스
description: 라이프엑스는 희귀난치질환 통합솔루션 '레어노트', 임신·육아 플랫폼 '마미톡'을 운영합니다.

name: 라플라스테크놀로지스
description: 라플라스 애널리틱스는 커머스를 위한 AI 대시보드로, 고객의 커머스 데이터를 취합해 비즈니스 문제점을 진단하고 액션 플랜을 추천합니다.

name: 랩도쿠
description: 랩도쿠는 라이프스타일 프리미엄 브랜드 빌더입니다.

name: 렌트리
description: 렌트리는 불투명한 라이프스타일 렌탈 시장의 유통 문제를 해결하기 위한 원스탑 렌탈 플랫폼입니다.

name: 로보톰
description: AIoT 로보틱스 가구를 통해 미래의 주거를 혁신하는 스마트 리빙 솔루션 기업

name: 롸잇
description: 원포인트는 탑티어 프리랜서 매칭 서비스입니다.

name: 루덴시티
description: 하우스오브는 퀄리티 높은 디자이너브랜드를 소개하는 편집샵 서비스입니다.

name: 뤼튼테크놀로지스
description: 우리나라를 대표하는 생성 AI 스타트업입니다.

name: 리멤버앤컴퍼니
description: 리멤버앤컴퍼니는 대한민국 직장인을 위한 프로페셔널 네트워크 서비스 리멤버의 운영사입니다. 2017년 라인플러스/네이버에 인수되며 성장의 발판을 마련했고, 2025년 글로벌 PEF EQT에 인수되며 HR 테크 분야 최대 엑시트 사례를 기록했습니다.

name: 리트리버
description: 기업 규제/인증 대응 업무의 효율적 관리를 돕는 AI 기반 컴플라이언스 자동화 솔루션입니다.

name: 링더벨
description: 링더벨은 자연에서 찾은 성분을 기능적으로 업그레이드하여 혁신적인 뷰티 솔루션을 제공합니다.

name: 마이리얼트립
description: 마이리얼트립은 국내 최고, 최대의 여행 슈퍼앱입니다.

name: 마이허브
description: maiLink는 다양한 의료 AI 솔루션을 통합하는 플랫폼입니다.

name: 마일코퍼레이션
description: 마일코퍼레이션은 선택의 품질은 높이고, 수수료와 임대료는 낮춰주는 AI 공인중개사 'MOA(모아)'를 운영합니다.

name: 먼치팩토리
description: 아워플레이스는 콘텐츠 제작을 위한 장소 중개 플랫폼입니다.

name: 모비데이즈
description: 모비데이즈는 2022년 10월 코스닥에 상장한 기업으로, 데이터 기반의 종합 디지털 마케팅 서비스와 독자적인 애드테크(AD-Tech) 솔루션을 제공하는 Full-stack 디지털 마케팅 그룹입니다.

name: 뮤팟
description: 뮤팟은 국내 15만 명의 영상편집자와 기업이 사용하는 영상용 배경음악, 효과음, 템플릿 폰트 올인원 구독 서비스입니다.

name: 미드나잇웨이브
description: 음원을 기반으로 콘텐츠, 커머스 등 다양한 사업 분야와 연계해 자체 IP 생태계를 만들어가는 엔터테인먼트 기업입니다.

name: 미메틱스
description: 미메틱스는 3차원 계층 돔 형태의 문어 흡반 구조 모사 피부 패치 기술에 기반한 유효성분의 피부 내 전달에 대한 솔루션을 제공합니다.

name: 바른행정
description: 행정업무를 새롭게 리브랜딩하고, IT를 기반으로 균일화 된 가치를 창출하는 행정종합 솔루션 회사

name: 밴플
description: TAE743는 일상 속 피부 리듬 회복에 집중한 슬로우 에이징 스킨케어 브랜드입니다.

name: 버블쉐어
description: 버블쉐어는 언어의 한계 없이 오가닉 마케팅을 가능하게 하는 솔루션입니다.

name: 버킷플레이스
description: 오늘의집은 공간과 관련된 모든 문제를 해결하는 라이프스타일 슈퍼앱입니다.

name: 브리치
description: 비플로우는 다양한 마켓플레이스를 한 번에 입점 및 운영할 수 있는 통합 커머스 판매 솔루션입니다.

name: 브릿지웍스
description: 캐시모어는 매장 첫 방문 소비자에게 현금 캐시백을 제공하고 매장에는 꾸준한 신규 고객 유입을 만들어주는 캐시백 앱입니다.

name: 블랙탠저린
description: 코콘은 퍼스널 컬러, 체형, 취향 등 사용자의 신체 데이터를 바탕으로 개인화 패션 큐레이션을 제공합니다.

name: 블루시그넘
description: 블루시그넘은 기술로 정신건강을 혁신하는 스타트업으로, 우울한 날 가장 먼저 생각나는 서비스라는 비전을 위해 일하고 있습니다.

name: 블리몽키즈
description: 마카롱은 인도 중심의 K-뷰티 유통 플랫폼입니다.

name: 비트블루
description: 버추얼셀럽 가치성장 플랫폼 '알트타운(ALT.TOWN)'과 Web3 기반 개인 가치 시각화 서비스 ‘Know-Yourself’를 운영 중입니다.

name: 사운드짐
description: 사운드짐은 모든 사람이 합리적인 가격에 전문적인 운동트레이닝을 받을 수 있는 콘텐츠를 제공합니다.

name: 사일런티스트
description: 사일런티스트는 가상자산 투자 솔루션을 개발합니다.

name: 상상텃밭
description: 수직농장 엔지니어링을 전문적으로 하고 있으며, 자체 농장도 운영하고 있습니다.

name: 샐러리파이
description: 샐러리파이는 회사가 직원에게 대출을 해 줄 때 발생하는 위험을 관리하고 해결합니다.

name: 서지컬마인드
description: 아크록서(AcroXeR)는 의료 전문가가 안전하고 성공적인 의료 서비스를 제공할 수 있도록 XR 기술과 AI를 결합한 포괄적인 전문 솔루션입니다.

name: 세이프틱스
description: 세이프틱스는 로봇 안전 지능을 개발합니다.

name: 센트비
description: 센트비는 한국, 싱가포르, 인도네시아 개인용 해외송금 서비스 '센트비'와, 기업용 해외 결제/송금 서비스 '센트비즈/센다'를 서비스합니다.

name: 셀러노트
description: 디지털 기반의 수출입물류 포워딩 서비스 '쉽다', 리셀러를 위한 글로벌 식음료 소싱 솔루션 '위딜라이즈'

name: 솜씨당컴퍼니
description: 솜씨당은 누적구매자 200만, 콘텐츠 27만개, 작가 2.7만명을 보유한 국내 최대 취미·여가 플랫폼입니다.

name: 쇼퍼블
description: The Fepi는 브랜드 OEM 공장 잉여재고를 직접 소싱하여 판매하는 SEA 오프프라이스 (Off-price) 플랫폼입니다.

name: 스마투스코리아
description: 스마투스는 광센서를 이용한 정량화된 치아우식 진단 및 측정 의료기기 장비입니다.

name: 스캐터랩
description: 유저가 일주일에 10시간을 체류하는 AI 엔터테인먼트 서비스 "제타"를 만들고 있습니다.

name: 스크리나
description: 카라라는 버추얼 유튜버들의 노래 방송을 보조하는 프로그램입니다.

name: 스타일쉐어
description: 스타일쉐어는 10~20대 여성을 주 타깃으로 하는 국내 1위 패션·뷰티 커뮤니티 기반의 커머스 플랫폼입니다. 2021년 국내 최대 패션 플랫폼 무신사에 인수되었습니다.

name: 스텝하우
description: 스텝하우 팀은 사내 문서 탐색, 분석, 활용 등 문서 업무를 자동화하는 AI 솔루션 'Wissly'를 운영하고 있습니다.

name: 시소
description: 시소는 N잡러 기반의 스타트업 방식의 애자일한 아웃소싱 솔루션을 제공하고, 채용공고 데이터를 수집 분석해 AI 기반 커리어 탐색 서비스를 제공합니다.

name: 시프티
description: 시프티는 출퇴근 기록, 근무 일정, 휴가, 전자결재 등을 통합 제공하는 국내 선도적인 통합 인력관리 SaaS(서비스형 소프트웨어) 솔루션입니다. 2022년 비즈니스온에 인수된 후, 2024년 스카이레이크 에쿼티 파트너스가 인수하여 독립 경영 체제로 전환하며 성장세를 이어가고 있습니다.

name: 아르토에이아이
description: 산업 현장을 위한 온디바이스 음성 AI를 개발합니다.

name: 아슬론
description: 아슬론은 12-lead ECG 데이터로 관상동맥 협착을 조기 예측하여 심근경색을 예방하는 인공지능 솔루션 기업입니다.

name: 아이와트립
description: 아이와트립은 영유아 동반 가족을 위한 프리미엄 여행 및 체험 상품 플랫폼 '동키' 운영사입니다. 2022년 국내 대표 트래블테크 기업 마이리얼트립에 인수되었습니다.

name: 알로하팩토리
description: 알로하팩토리는 자체 솔루션(플라밍고)을 통한 라이트코어 캐주얼게임 개발/퍼블리싱/마케팅 서비스를 제공합니다.

name: 알파아시아
description: 워프코퍼레이션은 스포츠 IP 기반의 마케팅 상품을 개발합니다.

name: 애딧앤아크코퍼레이션
description: AI로 인스타그램 오가닉뷰 광고 시장을 개척하는 K-컬처 비즈니스 플랫폼

name: 앤트
description: 랩노트는 바이오, 나노, 화학 분야에 특화된 연구 데이터 통합 기록 및 관리 솔루션입니다.

name: 어글리랩
description: 어글리랩은 쓰레기 배출의 번거로움을 해결하는 문전수거 서비스 '오늘수거'를 운영하는 스타트업입니다.

name: 언커먼홈
description: 나르카는 헤어&바디케어의 Restore & Restyle 브랜드 입니다.

name: 업스테어스
description: 폰가비는 중고폰 견적 산정·비교 서비스를 제공하는 온라인 중고폰 거래 중개 플랫폼입니다.

name: 에스테이트클라우드
description: 우대빵은 아파트 매물보유 1위 중개기업으로 전통적인 중개서비스에 기술을 더해 고객들에게 더 나은 중개서비스 경험을 제공합니다.

name: 에이든랩
description: 인코드8은 AI 기반 글로벌 마케팅&이커머스 솔루션입니다.

name: 에이아이닷엠
description: 셀롸이트는 상세페이지 상품 설명을 자동 생성하는 서비스입니다.

name: 에임인텔리전스
description: 생성형 AI 보안 진단 및 취약점 자동 탐지/차단 솔루션

name: 에프랩앤컴퍼니
description: 에프랩은 상위 1% 개발자들의 멘토링으로 계층 이동의 사다리를 만듭니다.

name: 엔츠
description: 엔스코프는 기업을 위한 탄소중립 관리 플랫폼입니다.

name: 엠젯패밀리
description: 엠젯패밀리는 웹툰, 웹소설 및 굿즈를 제작 및 유통하는 글로벌 콘텐츠 기업입니다.

name: 예스비
description: K 브랜드와 전세계 바이어를 연결하는 플랫폼 서비스로, 효율적인 공급망 관리를 지원합니다.

name: 오내피플
description: 캐치시큐는 AI 및 SaaS 기반 개인정보보호 규제 자동화 준수 서비스입니다.

name: 오앤비스페이스
description: 오앤비스페이스는 독자적인 위성 기술과 고정밀 우주 데이터를 바탕으로 뉴스페이스 시대를 선도하는 딥테크 우주 스타트업입니다.

name: 오픈에셋
description: 오픈에셋은 금융기관들의 자산을 혁신적인 토큰으로 전환시키는 블록체인 기반 솔루션을 제공합니다.

name: 옴니어스
description: 옴니커머스는 태깅, 추천, 개인화, 상품 관리 및 분석 등 고객의 쇼핑 경험을 향상시키는 이커머스 필수 AI 솔루션을 제공합니다.

name: 옵트에이아이
description: 옵트에이아이는 엣지 AI 도입을 위한 최적화 기술을 제공합니다.

name: 와이즈모바일
description: 파킹박은 주차장 정보를 제공하고 제휴된 주차장의 주차권을 할인 판매하는 서비스입니다.

name: 와이피랩스
description: 커넥팅은 음성 커뮤니케이션을 기반으로 사람과 사람이 연결되는 방식을 혁신하는 서비스입니다.

name: 우트
description: 타입스는 만나고 싶은 사람들과 원할 때 모일 수 있는 모바일 솔루션 앱입니다.

name: 운칠기삼

name: Addex
description: Addex Therapeutics is a development stage company focused on advancing innovative oral small molecules against rare diseases utilizing its pioneering allosteric modulation-based drug discovery platform.

name: Aegerion
description: Aegerion Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the development and commercialization of innovative therapies for patients with debilitating rare diseases.

name: Aldena Therapeutics
description: Aldena Therapeutics is developing groundbreaking siRNA-based medicines for dermatological diseases.

name: Altesa BioSciences
description: Altesa is a clinical stage pharmaceutical company developing medicines to treat respiratory virus in areas of high unmet clinical need.

name: Alys Pharmaceuticals
description: Alys Pharmaceuticals is a pioneering force in immuno-dermatology.

name: ApcinteX
description: Engineered serpin inhibitor of the anticoagulant APC pathway to treat haemophilia, even in patients with inhibitory antibodies to coagulation factors.

name: Ariad
description: ARIAD Pharmaceuticals is an integrated global oncology company focused on transforming the lives of cancer patients with breakthrough medicines. ARIAD is working on new medicines to advance the treatment of various forms of chronic and acute leukemia, lung cancer and other difficult-to-treat cancers.

name: Aura
description: Aura are developing a new class of therapies to target and destroy cancer cells selectively, while leaving surrounding tissue unharmed - an approach they call molecular surgery. Their lead program in ocular melanoma (OM), also known as choroidal or uveal melanoma, is designed to remove cancer cells in the back of the eye as a first-line therapy, while allowing for the potential of preserving patients' vision.

name: BioXell
description: BioXell is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery and development of drugs that exploit novel mechanisms of action to treat important urological, inflammatory, and related disorders with significant unmet medical needs. The Company was founded in 2002 as a spin-out from Roche.

name: Breakpoint Therapeutics
description: Breakpoint Therapeutics mission is to develop first and best-in-class oncology drugs that interfere with DNA repair and replication stress pathways to facilitate the cure of therapy-resistant cancers.

name: Capella
description: Our strategy is to use innovative technologies to develop novel medicines based on monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) to the next generation of important therapeutic targets in oncology and autoimmune disease.

name: Cellzome
description: CellZome is a leader in the development and advancement of proteomics technologies.

name: Centessa Pharmaceuticals
description: Centessa Pharmaceuticals - Acquired by Eli Lilly

name: Checkmate Pharmaceuticals, Inc
description: Checkmate Pharmaceuticals is developing Vidutolimod, a Toll-like Receptor 9 agonist for the treatment of Cancer. Checkmate is listed on NASDAQ and is currently executing several clinical studies, most advanced is metastatic melanoma where Vidutolimod is being tested in combination with pembrolizumab in both front-line and checkpoint experienced patient populations.

name: CoMentis
description: CoMentis is focused on the research and development of small molecule drugs to treat CNS disorders.

name: Critical Pressure
description: A virtual biopharmaceutical company developing products to treat vascular dysfunction and shock, with initial focus on severe sepsis.

name: Curevo
description: Curevo is a vaccine development company whose lead product is amezosvatein, an adjuvanted sub-unit vaccine to prevent shingles.

name: D3 Bio
description: D3 Bio is a globally focused biotechnology company focusing on developing and registration of innovative medicines in oncology and immunology.

name: Depth Charge
description: A discovery-stage company developing masked and targeted immunocytokines against solid tumours, addressing the limitations of current immunocytokine products in the clinic.

name: Egalet
description: A specialty pharmaceutical company focused on pain management, Egalet is developing tamper-resistant opioids, based on its patented erosion-based technology for drug delivery, designed to deter abuse.

name: Ethyreal Bio
description: Ethyreal is developing precision therapies for thyroid diseases with high unmet needs.

name: Evotec SE
description: Evotec is a global drug discovery and development company. Leveraging its data-driven multimodality platform. Evotec applies a unique combination of innovative technologies for the discovery and development of first-in-class and best-in-class therapeutics for both proprietary as well as partnered research.

name: Fore Biotherapeutics
description: A personalized medicine diagnostics company assessing the activity of mutations and combination of mutations and their response to targeted drugs.

name: Funxional Therapeutics
description: Funxional Therapeutics Ltd (FXT) is a privately held, clinical stage pharmaceutical company, focussing on novel anti-inflammatory therapies that exploit a new pathway discovered by FXT.

name: Gadeta
description: T cell therapy based on metabolic differences between tumour cells and healthy tissue.

name: Genmab
description: Genmab is an international biotechnology company focused on developing fully human antibody therapeutics for the potential treatment of cancer. It has a co-development and commercialization agreement with GSK.

name: Gensight
description: GenSight Biologics is a privately owned biopharmaceutical company, dedicated to the development and commercialization of gene therapy based treatments of retinal degenerative diseases.

name: GlycoVaxyn
description: GlycoVaxyn is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and manufacture of next-generation glycoconjugate vaccines utilizing its proprietary recombinant DNA technology.

name: Graegis
description: Graegis is developing a topically delivered reactive-oxygen species (ROS) scavenger for the management of radiation-induced dermatitis and oral mucositis in oncology.

name: Granular Therapeutics Limited
description: Granular Therapeutics is developing novel antibody therapeutics that selectively target mast cells for disease-modifying immune modulation with improved safety profile.

name: Imhotex Limited
description: Imhotex is developing novel therapeutics to treat Crohn's disease.

name: Impact Biomedicines
description: Impact is advancing a late-stage pipeline centered around fedratinib, a potent and highly selective JAK2 kinase inhibitor. This is being developed for the treatment of myelofibrosis (MF) and other refractory blood cancers.

name: Inexia
description: Inexia aims to develop intranasally administered orexin positive modulators for the the treatment of neurological diseases.

name: Janpix
description: Inhibitors of STAT3/5 signaling to treat hematological tumors & GBM.

name: Kaerus Bioscience Limited
description: Kaerus Bioscience is developing genetically-targeted therapeutics for rare neurodevelopmental disorders across the autism spectrum.

name: KliRNA
description: KliRNA is a discovery-stage company developing sirRNA therapies for chronic neuropathic itch. The Company is pursuing radically different targets to shift the treatment paradigm to biannual dosing in this indication.

name: Kurome Therapeutics
description: Launched in 2020, Kurome® Therapeutics is developing therapies that target cancer cells that have co-opted immune signaling pathways in order to avoid destruction by traditional therapeutic agents and subvert adaptive resistance mechanisms.

name: Levicept
description: Levicept discovered and is developing a novel first in class and safe biological agent (p75NTR-Fc) for the treatment of chronic pain.

name: LinguaFlex
description: LinguaFlex is a medical device company with a revolutionary patent pending technology to treat obstructive sleep apnea.

name: Merus N.V
description: Merus is a clinical-stage oncology company developing innovative full-length human bispecific and trispecific antibody therapeutics using the proprietary Multiclonics® Platform.

name: Micromet
description: Micromet is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development and commercialisation of innovative antibody-based therapies for the treatment of cancer.

name: Minerva Neurosciences
description: Minerva Neurosciences is a bio-pharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialisation of a portfolio of clinical stage product candidates to treat patients suffering from central nervous system diseases.

name: Mirobio
description: Development of checkpoint agonist antibodies for the treatment of autoimmune and inflammatory diseases

name: Molecular Partners
description: is pioneering the development of a novel class of targeted protein therapeutics termed DARPins, which are as target-specific and potent as monoclonal antibodies.

name: Morphogen-IX
description: Development of Bone Morphogenetic Protein 9/10 for the treatment of Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension.

name: New Amsterdam
description: Investigating obicetrapib, an oral, low-dose and once-daily CETP inhibitor, as the preferred LDL-C lowering therapy to be used as an adjunct to maximally tolerated statin therapy for high-risk cardiovascular disease ("CVD") patients.

name: Nira
description: Nira is a preclinical company developing photosensitizer antibody-drug conjugates for inflammatory skin diseases and chronic T-Cell lymphoma.

name: Novocure
description: Novocure is a public commercial-stage oncology company dedicated to the advancement of tumor treating fields (TTF) therapy for patients with solid tumours.

name: Oncoethix
description: Founded in 2009, OncoEthix is a Swiss-based biotechnology Company that is developing a small portfolio of oncology drug candidates.

name: Orexia
description: Orexia aims to develop orally administered orexin positive modulators for the treatment of neurological diseases.

name: Ottimo Pharma
description: Ottimo Pharma is focused on the development of pioneering bi-functional medicines to extend the lives of people living with cancer.

name: Padlock Therapeutics
description: Padlock is taking a whole new approach to treating autoimmune diseases, by developing new drugs that block the protein-arginine deiminases (PADs).

name: Palladio Biosciences
description: Palladio Bio is a clinical stage company developing transformative medicines for orphan diseases of the kidney. The company’s lead drug is the vasopressin V2 receptor antagonist lixivaptan for Polycystic Kidney Disease.

name: PanGenetics
description: PanGenetics is an antibody development company with a focus on inflammation and oncology. In November 2009, Abbott, acquired the PG110 anti-NGF antibody to treat chronic pain and second molecule PG102 spun out to create Fast Forward Pharma.

name: Parallele Bioscience
description: ParAllele Bioscience enables highly multiplexed SNP identification and discovery. The technology delivers higher throughput at a lower cost and requires lower sample quantities than competing methods.

name: Pearl River
description: PearlRiver is a biotech company with the mission to discover and develop best-in-class inhibitors to target cancers with oncogenic mutations that are difficult to address.

name: Perfect Balance Limited
description: Perfect Balance is developing novel therapeutics to re-balance the dysregulated immune system for inflammatory conditions.

name: Petalion Therapeutics
description: Petalion Therapeutics develops novel targeted dendrimer conjugate therapies for cancer patients.

name: Phathom Pharmaceuticals
description: Phathom is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of novel treatments for gastrointestinal (GI) diseases and disorders. The company is advancing the clinical drug candidate vonoprazan, a novel potassium-competitive acid blocker (P-CAB). Vonoprazan has the potential to address multiple unmet needs among patients with gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and other acid-related disorders.

name: Profibrix
description: - Acquired by The Medicines Company (NASDAQ: MDCO)

name: ProfoundBio
description: Aiming to help patients with cancer through discovery and development of novel targeted therapy with curative potential.

name: RAPT Therapeutics
description: RAPT is a clinical stage biotech advancing a half-life extended anti-immunoglobulin E (IgE) monoclonal antibody for food allergy.

name: Rivus Pharmaceuticals, Inc
description: Rivus is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on advancing cardiometabolic health. The company's pipeline of oral therapies includes HU6 in Phase 2 for MASH and RV-8451 in IND-enabling studies for obesity.

name: Sequenta
description: Sequenta is a biotech company dedicated to the discovery and development of clinical diagnostics based on a revolutionary new platform for understanding immune system status. A profound revolution in the cost of DNA sequencing has enabled the company to develop novel approaches to measuring the most variable part of the human genome: the immune cell receptor genes.

name: Synthorx
description: Synthorx is a biotechnology company using their proprietary synthetic biology platform starting with our novel DNA base pair, to discover and develop new protein therapeutics. The initial focus is on cytokines for use in oncology.

name: T-Cypher Bio
description: At T-Cypher Bio we generate TCR-based therapeutics that have the potential to transform the treatment of solid tumours, autoimmune, inflammatory, and infectious diseases.

name: T.O.A.D Oncology
description: T.O.A.D. Oncology is developing a next-generation antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) that targets the Prostate Specific Membrane Antigen for metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer patients. Toad will leverage a proprietary linker-payload. The company has designed a fast track strategy to BLA submission.

name: UltraHuman
description: Developing novel, best in class immuno-oncology antibodies against clinically validated targets using a proprietary engineering platform.

name: V-Watch
description: V-Watch is developing and commercializing a clinically validated, ambulatory sleep monitoring system for disease diagnosis and monitoring.

name: Vaderis Therapeutics AG
description: Vaderis develops innovative therapeutics for rare diseases caused by vascular malformations with an initial focus on hereditary haemorrhagic telangiectasia.

name: Vaxcyte
description: Dedicated to the delivery of best-in-class conjugate vaccines and novel complex antigen-based vaccines to prevent serious infectious diseases.

name: Versanis Bio

Neutrolis employs the exDNASE platform, based on naturally occurring enzymes that degrade the extracellular chromatin that form NETs, and powers the creation of natural and engineered enzyme analogs that are capable of treating several acute and chronic unmet medical needs. The lead candidate NTR-441 is an enhanced analog of DNASE1L3, an enzyme produced by immune cells that degrades NETs into biologically inactive fragments to attenuate a severe immune response. The company’s pipeline includes NTR-441, systemically active engineered DNASE1L3, and NTR-452, locally active engineered DNASE1L3, that effectively removes NETs and halt their pathologic effects.

name: Advanced Navigation
description: Advanced Navigation is a Sydney-based developer of Positioning, Navigation and Timing (PNT) systems that provide users with highly accurate positioning data, even in environments where GPS signals are jammed, spoofed or unavailable. Founded in 2012, the company has since deployed over 100,000 systems to a global customer base.

name: Advemto
description: Advemto has developed, and demonstrated, a breakthrough technology for improving the measurement of fluorescent markers used across life sciences. The company is applying this core IP to Smart Plates: a consumable that links immune cell behaviour to genetic identity at single-cell scale, without requiring customers to purchase any new hardware.

name: Alimetry
description: Alimetry has developed diagnostic technology for gastric dysfunction, aiming to provide an “EKG for the stomach.” Its first product is a non-invasive wearable device that uses 64 electrodes to measure stomach muscle activity, with results transmitted wirelessly for clinician analysis and visualisation.

name: Atomic.io
description: Atomic.io is a low-code platform enabling enterprises to deliver highly personalised, interactive in-app messages securely and at scale. From nudging customers through key decisions to rewarding milestones and replacing costly SMS, the platform turns a company’s app into its most trusted and impactful communication channel.

name: Auror
description: Auror provides a crime intelligence system to brick-and-mortar retailers, used by front-line store employees, headquarters staff and the police to help prevent organised crime, reduce loss from theft and make stores feel safer for employees.

name: AutoGrab
description: AutoGrab is an Australian based automotive intelligence platform that provides real-time data and insights to dealers, insurers, lenders, and fleet operators, by offering a suite of products including live pricing, vehicle sourcing, inventory management, pre-accident valuations and fleet management.

name: Avasa
description: Avasa is a groundbreaking MedTech startup founded by surgeon-turned-bioengineer Dr. Nandoun Abeysekera, who developed a novel tubular tissue transformer to automate and standardise microvascular surgery procedures, specifically arterial anastomosis. This technology is poised to disrupt the current manual method, offering clinicians a precise, easy-to-adopt tool to improve patient clinical outcomes with minimal upskilling required.

name: B.Spkl
description: B.Spkl is developing a novel method for producing high-performance, low-cost catalysts, initially targeting the hydrogen electrolyser market. By using a single-stage process to vastly simplify the catalyst manufacturing process, the company creates significant cost savings and enables a more cost-effective and scalable production of clean Hydrogen.

name: Basis
description: With increased EVs, solar, and home energy electrification seen across the world, Basis developed a new smart panel, designed to replace traditional residential switchboards with a digital system that gives homeowners real-time visibility and control over their energy usage, modernising how household electricity is managed, improving safety and efficiency, and allowing faster installation compared to conventional switchboards.

name: Cadmus Animal Health
description: Cadmus Animal Health is a New Zealand-based company developing an immunotherapeutic for periodontal disease in companion animals. Rather than cleaning and extraction once damage is done, it trains the animal's immune system against the Porphyromonas bacteria that drive the disease. The company spun out of Denteric, a human health company built on University of Melbourne research into the same bacteria.

name: Crimson Education
description: Crimson Education was founded in 2013 with a focus on university admissions, and quickly expanded into a broader platform supporting high-performing students across their education journey. At its core is technology that enables personalised, data-driven learning and support at scale, informed by a growing dataset and consistently strong outcomes.

name: Dawn Aerospace
description: Dawn Aerospace is creating next-generation space transportation with a focus on building eco-friendly satellite propulsion systems and reusable spaceplane technology. It has become the world's leading supplier of green in-space propulsion, with more than 200 thrusters flown across 50-plus satellites. Its Mk-II Aurora, a rocket-powered suborbital spaceplane, is the first privately developed aircraft to fly supersonic since Concorde and is now taking commercial orders.

name: Evnex
description: Evnex produces AC (Alternating Current) electric vehicle chargers for homes and workplaces, paired with interoperable software that enables electricity distributors to dynamically manage when chargers draw power from the network. They currently facilitate the largest network of residential and workplace chargers in NZ and have relationships with more than ten electricity distributors including Vector and Powerco.

name: Fleet Space Technologies
description: Fleet Space Technologies is an Australian company building the leading platform for mineral exploration. It pairs proprietary satellite and sensor technology with an AI model to produce 3D subsurface models in hours rather than months, improving outcomes and lowering environmental impact for miners. The technology also extends to defence and space.

name: Hnry
description: Founded in 2017, Hnry is an all-in-one financial platform for sole traders, integrating payments, banking, accounting tools, and professional accountancy across New Zealand, Australia, and the United Kingdom. Beyond tax, it streamlines end-to-end financial administration across 300+ verticals through a fully integrated, automated solution.

name: Kindo
description: Founded in 2010, Kindo began as a solution to a common parenting challenge: to make healthy school lunches easy for families and effortless for schools. Since then, it has evolved to become New Zealand's leading school payments platform, supporting lunches, payments and e-commerce for schools nationwide.

name: Kry10
description: The Kry10 Operating System (KOS) and Platform is a new operating system and management service aimed directly at connected devices. Unlike alternatives, it is highly secure, providing ultimate protection from attack. Founded by Boyd Multerer, ex-Microsoft and the technical brains behind the Xbox live architecture, the platform is designed for industrial systems, infrastructure, transport, and government.

name: LawVu
description: LawVu is an NZ mid-market SaaS company selling software servicing; matters, contracts, insights and other capabilities to in-house legal teams primarily in NZ, the UK and US. The cloud-based platform was looking to take advantage of the movement of corporate functions towards digital adoption, giving legal departments a clearer view of operations and providing a complete end-to-end system.

name: Mint Innovation
description: Every year, more than US$80 billion worth of valuable metals are lost to waste, with electronic and automotive waste accounting for around half of that total. Recognising both the challenge and opportunity, Mint Innovation developed the world's first biorefinery using their patented biometallurgical process to sustainably extract critical metals (such as gold, palladium and copper) from electronic waste and other feedstocks, helping build more resilient and circular supply chains for the materials our world increasingly depends on.

name: Miruku
description: Miruku is developing a novel technique for producing alternative dairy proteins through a molecular farming platform. Their approach involves growing proteins directly in plants, where cells are recruited as mini-factories to produce proteins, fats, and sugars that are normally only sourced from animals. The four founding team members are considered to be among the best in the world in their fields, both scientifically and commercially.

name: Open
description: Open is a digital insurance platform that provides the backend technology for brands to offer embedded insurance products to their customers. The company aims to make insurance simple, accessible and affordable for everyone.

name: ParkHelp
description: ParkHelp (originally Parking Sense) offered parking guidance and curbside management technology. The company had expanded globally and developed its product portfolio as it positioned itself as a leader in digitising the global parking industry.

name: Portainer.io
description: Portainer provides an operational toolset to simplify the use of container orchestration systems. Its products give enterprise IT and operational technology teams a single control plane to deploy, govern and update container workloads across multi-cluster, edge and air-gapped environments. The software has had remarkable engagement around the world, with over 2b pulls and 500k developers and IT engineers using it monthly (and growing).

name: PowerbyProxi
description: PowerbyProxi first began as a spin-out from the University of Auckland’s Engineering School, built on nearly three decades of wireless power research, and successfully commercialised its technology across industrial and consumer applications. Heralded as a developer of the world’s most advanced and safest wireless power system, it was acquired by Apple in October 2017.

name: Re-Leased
description: Built for owners, operators, and investors, Re-Leased streamlines property management with intelligent workflows that save time, reduce costs, and minimise risk, while providing a single source of truth across portfolios with instant visibility into performance, compliance, and operations.

name: RespirAq
description: RespirAq is a MedTech company developing a humidification system for hospital ventilators. Patients who rely on ventilators need humidified air to protect and maintain their airways, but typically systems depend on external water-based components and complex setups. RespirAq’s Active Humidifier removes the need for added water by using a smart membrane and integrated heating to manage moisture directly, improving reliability in critical care settings — an innovation that has since earned U.S. FDA Breakthrough Device Designation.

name: RosterLab
description: Born from the founders PhD’ research, RosterLab’s AI-driven engine is revolutionising hospital rostering. Its SaaS solution uses a proprietary algorithm to streamline staff scheduling, managing over 50 rules simultaneously (incl. union regulations, staff preferences, and skill sets), to reduce rostering time by up to 90%. By freeing senior physicians from admin and prioritising staff preferences, RosterLab enables its customers to unlock improved efficiency and staff retention, and reduce burnout.

name: Solve
description: Solve provides enterprises with a real-time data warehousing and management solution which can be hosted in the customer’s own cloud, acting as a single source of truth, reconciling all of the customer engagement and touchpoints as well as providing audit trails for all database changes.

name: Static Technologies
description: Static Technologies is a New Zealand FinTech startup taking an offensive approach to fraud and scams. While conventional tools detect phishing and scam campaigns after the fact, Static intervenes while an attack is still running, disrupting criminal operations and generating actionable intelligence so organisations can stop losses before money moves. The platform focuses on the early stages of an attack, the window that carries most of the damage and the one traditional fraud and cyber tools tend to miss. It is purpose-built for the institutions fraudsters impersonate to gain legitimacy: banks, telcos and government agencies. Static works across New Zealand and Australia and is expanding into North America.

name: SupaHuman
description: SupaHuman has developed an AI compliance and authoring platform for vocational education providers. It codifies each provider's way of working to generate audit-defensible assessment and moderation materials, keeps them compliant as standards change, and gives educators more time to focus on better learner outcomes.

name: Tectrax
description: Tectrax has developed an electronic amphibious system for the aluminium boat market. The company partners worked with NZ’s leading boat builders to fit amphibious systems to aluminium or fibre-glass hulls, allowing the company to leverage OEM sales channels, give boat owners access to amphibious technology without changing brands, and showcase NZ boat manufacturers in international markets.

name: Timely
description: Timely is a specialist provider of appointment management and point of sale systems targeted at the beauty industry. EverCommerce, a US-based service commerce platform, saw the opportunity to build out their Fitness and Wellness portfolio through a bolt-on acquisition of Timely in 2021.

name: TracPlus
description: Built on 20 years of experience delivering tracking, telemetry, and operational intelligence to mission-critical environments, TracPlus provides aerial firefighting teams with a real-time view of aircraft, drops, and operations. With a strong focus on safety, efficiency, and precision, it helps wildfire agencies coordinate faster and respond with confidence.

name: TradeMe
description: Founded in 1998, TradeMe was a pioneer of NZ’s online C2C marketplace and online customer acquisition and endures as a dominant local platform and player. It was sold to Fairfax Media in 2006 for $750 million.

name: Tradify
description: Tradify was founded by then-tradie Curtis Bailey, who was frustrated by the paperwork involved in running a trade business. The platform simplifies essential workflows including quoting, invoicing, job tracking, and payments, making it easier to manage core business tasks and focus on the work itself. It was sold to the Access Group in 2024.

name: Unleashed Software
description: Unleashed provides manufacturing companies with tools that help them streamline operations and manage inventory. Founded in 2009, the company now has over 2,000 customers in key markets – NZ, AUS, the US and UK. In 2020, the company was acquired by Access Group, a leading provider of business management software to mid-sized UK companies.

name: Vend
description: Shortly after the first iPad came out, Vaughan Fergusson recognised the opportunity to leverage the hardware as a Point of Sale (POS) solution, thus launching cloud POS software company Vend. As a specialist provider of a cloud based retail system, Vend became well established globally with over 11,000 clients in 140 countries (as at 2016).

name: Wellumio
description: Wellumio is developing a revolutionary imaging technology that harnesses the power of nuclear magnetic resonance for communities that are least able to access MRI. The company's first product, Axana, is a portable brain scanning device that enables paramedics and first responders to rapidly identify and characterise stroke in patients. The Wellumio team brought deep domain expertise and prior startup experience, an ideal blend of skills befitting the company’s needs. Both founders had previously started companies in relevant industries and had worked together for a number of years prior.

name: ZeroJet
description: ZeroJet is creating the world’s first turnkey electric jet propulsion unit for boats. Doing much more than electrifying marine propulsion, its fully enclosed electric jet propulsion system improves safety by eliminating exposed propellers, enhances usability through quieter operation, and delivers strong performance while reducing environmental impact.

name: Al Clearing
description: AI Clearing provides AI powered monitoring of infrastructure projects using drone data for fast progress and quality insights.

Radancy provides a best-in-class, global, cloud-based technology platform and consultative services that automate the recruitment process and provide a premium, personalized candidate experience, enabling customers to find the talent they need to support their business objectives. Radancy’s software platform includes a market-leading, integrated suite of technology solutions, including a best-in-class career site platform, programmatic advertising technology, candidate relationship management platform, and employee referrals software. New Mountain’s investment in Radancy is the product of its long-standing sector “deep dive” in the Human Capital Management space and a focus on investing behind businesses driving the “Future of Work,” which previously led to New Mountain’s investments in AMS and Beeline.

name: Real Chemistry
description: Real Chemistry, formerly W2O Group, is a global health innovation company, focused on delivering analytics-driven, digital-first solutions to the healthcare industry. Real Chemistry uses proprietary technology, healthcare-specific data analytics and deep subject matter expertise to enable its clients to efficiently engage with the broader healthcare ecosystem – including consumers, providers, physicians and payors – and address complex commercial challenges, such as physician education, clinical trial engagement, consumer disease awareness, patient engagement, brand positioning and value articulation. Real Chemistry employs over 1,600 people across a global office footprint and serves most of the top global biopharma companies. Real Chemistry was founded in 2001 by CEO Jim Weiss and is headquartered in San Francisco.

name: Remedy Partners
description: Founded in 2011 and based in Norwalk, CT, Remedy Partners is a leading technology, data, analytics, and services provider for the healthcare “bundled payments” sector, with offerings that both reduce healthcare costs and improve patient outcomes. Bundled payments link payments for the multiple services beneficiaries receive during an episode of care, enabling organizations to enter into payment arrangements that include financial and performance accountability for episodes of care. Remedy uses a proprietary database and advanced data and analytics to collaborate with health systems, at-risk providers, and employers in order to improve coordination of post-acute care. Remedy is allied with 175 acute care hospitals, 139 physician group practices, 540+ home health agencies, and 1,500+ skilled nursing facilities to drive improved patient outcomes. The Company’s data analytics team of in-house statisticians and actuaries analyze a health system’s historical patient mix, procedure mix, and spending patterns to design bundled payment programs. Remedy’s proprietary suite of software applications to manage bundled payments (“Episode Connect”), identifies patients eligible for a bundle, tracks patients through acute and post-acute care, and provides process and performance reports to care providers. Lastly, Remedy’s team of 120+ patient care coordinators interact extensively with patients in the hospital and post-discharge settings to ensure successful patient recovery and to reduce hospital readmissions. Key services include the development of a comprehensive, and patient specific care plan, the determination of the appropriate site for post-acute care, and 24/7 nurse call center to support patients through the episode of care.

name: RRC
description: RRC Companies is a leading multi-discipline engineering and technical services firm focused on utility-scale renewable power generation. The firm provides integrated engineering, SCADA systems integration, and specialized field services for solar, wind, battery energy storage, and broader power infrastructure projects, serving a diversified base of leading asset owners, developers, and contractors. New Mountain tracked RRC for several years as part of the firm’s long-standing infrastructure services and engineering & consulting (“E&C”) sector efforts. New Mountain’s track record of business building and partnership with power and energy infrastructure services businesses positioned NMC as the partner of choice for RRC’s founder and management team.

name: Salute
description: Salute provides comprehensive services across the full lifecycle of data centers, including facility operations and management, quality assurance and quality control inspection, and technical commissioning and retrofitting services. Driven by its commitment to reliable services and a broad range of end-to-end solutions, the Company serves a blue-chip customer base of leading data center asset owners and employs more than 1,200 dedicated professionals, approximately 40% of whom are veterans of the United States Armed Forces. New Mountain identified Salute as part of its multi-year sector deep-dive in infrastructure services. New Mountain has made significant prior and current investments as part of these sector initiatives, including TRC, Inframark, Qualus, Aegion, Cumming, Site 20/20, and Consor.

name: SAM
description: SAM is a leading independent provider of mission-critical geospatial and inspection services to the utility, transportation, and critical infrastructure industry, with roots dating back to 1994. The Company delivers an integrated suite of solutions across land and aerial surveying, subsurface utility engineering, construction and asset inspection, and digital data management, serving a diversified, blue-chip base of investor-owned utilities, transportation agencies, energy providers, and other infrastructure owners. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, SAM employs over 1,800 professionals. New Mountain’s investment in SAM is the product of its multi-year sector “deep dive” in geospatial services and a focus on investing behind businesses aligned with the growth and modernization of utility and other infrastructure assets.

name: Signify Health
description: Signify Health is a leading provider of in-home, technology-enabled healthcare services, partnering with health plans, pharma, and other risk-bearing organizations on its mission to improve quality of life by providing comprehensive care where and when it’s needed most. Deploying an intelligent technology platform and a nationwide network of physicians and nurses into the home and facility settings, Signify Health closes gaps in care and documentation for high-risk patients, which increases data accuracy and engages health plan members in ongoing care in their place of residence. In recent years, the company has adopted these robust capabilities to begin offering longitudinal complex care management in the place of greatest convenience for patients, most often their home. Signify Health’s field-based, multi-disciplinary complex care team provides ongoing care to address chronic conditions, prevent hospitalizations, and integrate medical, behavioral, and social determinants of health. Based on health plans’ provider network strategy, Signify Health’s clinical resources and technology platform can also be leveraged within the provider network to achieve financial and quality goals per its value-based contracts. Beyond reducing healthcare costs, this unified platform and expanded network helps health plans retain members and improve their quality of life. New Mountain formed Signify by combining CenseoHealth and Advance Health. New Mountain’s investment in Censeo and Advance came as a result of the firm’s long-standing deep dive effort in technology-enabled payor services, including investments in CIOX, Equian and Convey. New Mountain had been tracking Censeo for several years and reengaged with the company in March 2017. New Mountain also developed a relationship with the founders of Advance over the summer of 2017, with the intent of combining both businesses. Both management teams selected New Mountain as their preferred partner due to its deep payor services sector expertise, and the transactions were consummated on an exclusive basis in December 2017.

name: Site 20/20
description: Site 20/20 is an award-winning technology company, manufacturing and servicing hardware and software solutions for the traffic control and road construction industries. The Company developed the Guardian SmartFlagger (“GSF”), an integrated robotic flagging system for automating traffic control during roadside projects and infrastructure maintenance. The GSF, which is leased to customers as a subscription including training, service, and real time monitoring, increases safety and well-being for traffic control operators, and improves worksite efficiency. New Mountain’s investment in Site 20/20 is the product of its multi-year deep-dive sector initiative in infrastructure services & technology and builds on NMC’s experience with technology enablement of infrastructure field services.

name: SNL Financial
description: SNL Financial is a leading provider of industry-focused financial, business and market data, news, and analytics for the financial institutions, energy, real estate, media & communications, and metals & mining sectors. SNL serves over 4,200 customers, including many of the nation’s top investment and commercial banks, investment managers, consulting firms, corporations, and government agencies, through access to an in-depth electronic database, available online and updated 24/7. The Company has over 70,000 individual users of its products at these clients. SNL was founded in 1987. New Mountain acquired SNL on an exclusive basis outside of any auction process, driven by the firm’s multi-year and proactive “deep-dive” effort in the information services and database sector. New Mountain’s reputation for building businesses was particularly important to SNL’s owners and management team, who retained a large ongoing minority ownership stake in SNL.

name: Sonrava Health
description: Sonrava Health (f.k.a Western Dental) is one of the most experienced dental service organizations (DSOs) in the U.S., with a large-scale footprint of over 580 offices across 20 states. Sonrava Health’s team includes 1,400+ doctors and over 7,200 team members focused on providing high-quality, affordable dental and oral health care across more than 2.9 million patient visits per year. Sonrava Health’s differentiated platform focuses on providing high-quality, full-service dentistry at affordable prices (including general dentistry, specialty and orthodontic services), as well as administrative and management support services to affiliated dental offices. New Mountain’s decision to acquire Sonrava Health was made based on our firm’s multi-year and proactive “deep dive” effort in the dental sector, which also included intensive review of other prospects in the DSO space. New Mountain first proactively approached Sonrava Health regarding a potential partnership in 2011. New Mountain reinstated its dialogue with Sonrava Health in early 2012 and acquired the company later that year.

name: Sparta Systems
description: Sparta Systems (“Sparta”) is the leading provider of quality management software to the pharmaceutical, medical device, and consumer products industries. Sparta’s software solutions help improve quality outcomes and incident response, with improved regulatory compliance and lower administrative costs. The Company’s products are considered the “gold standard” within its markets, and Sparta’s flagship platform, TrackWise, is used by 35 of the top 40 pharma companies and 13 of the top 15 medical device manufacturers. Sparta has over 825,000 individual users overall across more than 30 countries. New Mountain’s investment in Sparta comes as a result of its longstanding efforts in the enterprise software, life sciences, and consumer product sectors, as well as the firm’s proactive “deep dive” effort in compliance and supply chain integrity.

name: Strayer Education, Inc.
description: Strayer Education, Inc. (NASD: STRA) is an education services holding company which owns Strayer University. Strayer’s mission is to make higher education achievable and convenient for working adults in today’s economy. Founded in 1892, Strayer University is a proprietary institution of higher learning accredited by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education. Strayer University offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs in business administration, accounting, information technology, education, and public administration. It serves more than 23,000 working adult students at 32 campuses in eight states in the eastern United States and worldwide via the Internet through Strayer University Online. Strayer University is committed to providing an education that prepares working adult students for advancement in their careers and professional lives. New Mountain proactively identified the post-secondary education sector as an area of industry focus beginning in early 2000. The Firm built a database of 4,000 properties in the space, hired executives from the industry to be in residence at the Firm and targeted approximately thirty companies to proactively pursue. During this process of top down industry analysis, the Firm became aware of the opportunity to invest in Strayer. In May 2001, New Mountain led a $150 million investment to acquire control of Strayer, and negotiated this transaction on an exclusive basis, without an auction. Strayer’s valuation and growth rate had been held back due to the illness of its then-CEO and the absence of management successors. Following the investment, two of New Mountain’s executives-in-residence were appointed as the CEO and COO of Strayer, and New Mountain’s CEO was elected as Strayer’s non-executive chairman. In addition, the Company adopted a new five-part growth strategy written for the company by New Mountain during its period of due diligence. As a result of these efforts and strategy, Strayer has grown from 12,000 students to 23,000, from 14 campuses to 32, from the Washington D.C. / Richmond area only into eight states, from a 12% growth rate in revenues to a 25% rate (without acquisitions), from a small on-line program to a substantial one and from a thin management team to a much stronger team. The company has achieved record revenues, earnings and enrollment each quarter of New Mountain’s ownership. Strayer’s market value has increased from approximately $400 million to approximately $1.5 billion, between the time New Mountain announced its intention to invest in November 2000 and year end 2004. The company has been debt free the entire time, and now has more then $120 million of cash and equivalents on hand, as of year end 2004. New Mountain sold its final shares of Strayer in August, 2005

name: Stroz Friedberg Inc.
description: Stroz Friedberg Inc., founded in 2000, is a global digital risk management and investigations firm specializing in digital forensics, data breach and cybercrime response, electronic discovery, and business intelligence and investigations. Working at the crossroads of technology, law, and behavioral science, the firm helps corporations, advisory and law firms, governments and individuals manage the inherent risks and responsibilities of doing business in a digital era. Stroz Friedberg is often engaged in crisis situations to help protect its clients’ intellectual property, financial, and reputational interests. Stroz Friedberg’s Co-Presidents include Ed Stroz, former head of the FBI’s Cyber Crime Unit, and Eric Friedberg, former U.S. Attorney in charge of cybercrimes prosecutions in New York. The Company’s senior professionals are drawn from an elite pool of former FBI Supervisory Special Agents, US Attorney’s Office Cybercrime Prosecutors, Senate General Counsel, and other government and legislative senior professionals. Together they deliver an unparalleled level of expertise in law, law enforcement, criminal investigations, information technology, and behavioral science to the firm’s clients. New Mountain evaluated Stroz Friedberg as part of a multi-year, proactive “deep dive” into the information security, federal services, software, and eDiscovery sectors. As a result of New Mountain’s prior relationships with Stroz Friedberg’s shareholders, proactive industry efforts and its reputation for building businesses, New Mountain was able to work with the Stroz Friedberg management team to make its investment outside of an auction process.

name: Summit Wash Holdings
description: Established in 2022, Summit Wash Holdings (“Summit”) was initially formed through a partnership with Russell Speeder’s Car Wash, a family-owned car wash platform with 21 locations across the Northeast, Nebraska, and Florida markets. Russell Speeder’s, which was founded in 1963 by the Shullman family, is known throughout the industry for its unparalleled quality, service, and customer experience. Following its initial formation, Summit has continued to focus on growth in its core Northeast market while also growing its presence in the Florida market through the acquisitions of Waters Wash in 2022 and Squeeky’s Car Wash in 2023. New Mountain formed Summit as a result of the Firm’s long-standing “deep dive” initiative in automotive aftermarket services. New Mountain had been tracking the car wash space for a number of years, including during the firm’s ownership of DRB Systems, and initiated proprietary discussions with Russell Speeder’s in 2022. New Mountain utilized a number of expert advisors to assist in due diligence and acquire the business outside of a formal auction process.

name: Surgis, Inc.
description: Surgis, Inc. was a company which was started from scratch by New Mountain. It grew to be the nation’s largest privately held surgical services company and one of the top six overall. Surgis owned and managed a nationwide network of ambulatory surgery centers in partnership with physicians and hospitals. In addition, the Company managed the surgical suites for a number of the nation’s leading hospitals. Through top down industry analysis, New Mountain had identified the surgical services sector as an area of proactive focus beginning in February 2001. New Mountain executives then spent nine months confirming this thesis, attending industry conferences, establishing relationships with key brokers, reviewing properties for sale and interviewing management teams. In November 2001, New Mountain created a “best in class” team to execute this industry strategy and agreed to commit $100 million of equity behind them. In August 2002, New Mountain and management completed their first major surgery center acquisition and formally announced the establishment of Surgis, Inc. Following New Mountain’s investment, the Company became one of the fastest growing surgical services companies in the history of the industry. Surgis executed numerous surgical center acquisitions and developed an impressive pipeline of organic growth and acquisition candidates. Acquisitions were completed at approximately half of the multiple paid for public company competitors. New Mountain worked closely with the management team to support the Company’s efforts in acquiring new centers, reviewing major strategic initiatives in new areas and building its infrastructure. In April 2006, Surgis was acquired by United Surgical Partners, Inc., producing a substantial gain for the Company and its shareholders.

name: Tinuiti
description: Founded in 2004, Tinuiti, Inc (“Tinuiti”) is a leading data-driven digital marketing firm focused on performance marketing and eCommerce. Tinuiti uses a tech-enabled model that leverages a proprietary data analytics platform and deep subject matter expertise to manage clients’ digital strategy and optimize execution across all digital channels. Tinuiti’s clients include leading brands across many end-market verticals including retail, CPG, home services, and eCommerce. Tinuiti’s capabilities span the digital marketing ecosystem, including search, marketplaces, programmatic, social, and email/CRM. New Mountain’s investment in Tinuiti is the product of the firm’s deep dive around digital marketing and digital transformation, which have previously resulted in investments such as IRI, W2O, and emids.

name: Topix Skin Health
description: Topix is the independent leader in professional & natural consumer skincare with a differentiated portfolio of clinically-proven products and brands sold across high-growth channels. Through its professional skincare segment, Topix develops custom brands created in partnership with leading dermatologists and sells to professional spas though the ClarityRx brand. Topix’s family of consumer brands include DermaE, the fastest growing skincare brand in the natural channel and Think, the leader in safe and clean sun care. Topix has a fully integrated platform with capabilities leveraged across all segments, including a robust library of proprietary and efficacious formulas and digital and omnichannel distribution across business lines. Topix is headquartered in New York where it maintains FDA-certified R&D and manufacturing capabilities and employs approximately 550 people. New Mountain’s investment in Topix was driven by our firm’s multi-year and proactive “deep-dive” efforts in the life sciences, health & wellness, aesthetics, and niche consumer products sectors. New Mountain first began a dialogue with Topix’s founder and CEO in March 2015. Topix decided that New Mountain’s deep expertise in healthcare products as well as its focus on growth and business-building made it the ideal partner to help Topix continue its growth and achieve the next level of success. Throughout diligence, New Mountain was able to leverage its broad network of relationships with industry executives and physicians, developed through our “deep-dives,” to identify and evaluate multiple, significant growth opportunities. Topix and New Mountain ultimately completed the transaction on a fully proprietary and exclusive basis in July 2016.

name: TRC Companies
description: TRC Companies (“TRC”) is a leading national engineering and consulting (“E&C”) firm providing services across the environmental, power, infrastructure, and energy end markets. A white-collar professional services firm founded in 1969, TRC has 5,500 highly skilled employees, as well as a strong reputation for quality and technical excellence in the industry. TRC provides environmental consulting, design & engineering, project management, and a range of other services to a diversified customer base, and focuses on low risk, small and medium size projects. TRC is headquartered in Lowell, Massachusetts. New Mountain acquired TRC as a result of the firm’s multi-year, proactive “deep dive” effort in the engineering & consulting and infrastructure services sectors. New Mountain first met TRC over five years before the investment in June 2017 and developed a strong relationship with the leadership team. As a result of its expertise in the sector and well developed strategic growth plan for TRC, management championed New Mountain as their preferred partner.

name: US Ocean
description: US Ocean is a leading “asset light” logistics business operating six U.S.-flagged multipurpose and heavy lift vessels. US Ocean primarily focuses on cargoes that are too heavy, large, or expensive to travel in traditional drybulk or container ships. Vessels in the US Ocean fleet have unique characteristics that are well-suited for worldwide cargo transport including heavy lift capabilities up to 900 metric tons, ice class, sprinkler outfitting, lift-on/lift-off, roll-on/roll-off, and float-on/float-off. US Ocean is routinely sought out by customers with a wide range of transport and maintains long-term relationships with a broad range of blue-chip private clients and established government agencies, including branches of the U.S. military. Five of US Ocean’s six vessels are enrolled in the 60-vessel Maritime Security Program (“MSP”), an exclusive program which provides military access to privately-owned vessels that are ready to meet national defense priorities. US Ocean is headquartered in Houston, TX.

name: Valet Waste
description: Valet Waste is the leading national provider of doorstep trash and recycling collection to the multifamily housing industry. Valet was founded in 1995 and has pioneered the industry since that time, growing from just a concept to over 600,000 units under management today. Valet Waste benefits all property constituencies by improving the quality of residents’ experience, decreasing on-site maintenance stress and providing an additional revenue opportunity for property owners. As a result, Valet’s service has consistently been ranked among the top 3 most desired amenities by residents and property owner/management. Valet Waste is based in Tampa, Florida and is the only national provider of five night a week doorstep waste and recycling collection to the multi-family housing industry, with operations in over 25 major markets. New Mountain acquired its ownership position in Valet Waste in August 2007 through the acquisition of its parent company Oakleaf Global Holdings, Inc. New Mountain identified Oakleaf as part of a long-standing proactive focus on the facilities service and environmental services space. In July 2011, New Mountain sold Oakleaf Global Holdings, Inc. to Waste Management. However, New Mountain elected to spin-off and retain Valet Waste because the firm saw significant opportunity for long-term growth and value creation at Valet.

name: Validus Holdings, Ltd.
description: Validus Holdings, Ltd. (NYSE: VR) is a Bermuda-based holding company formed in December 2005 to respond to the imbalance between supply and demand for short-tail reinsurance that resulted from the unprecedented catastrophic activity of 2004 and 2005. Through Validus Re, a newly-formed Bermuda Class 4 reinsurance company, the company writes property catastrophe, per risk, marine and energy, retrocession and other specialty short-tail lines of business. In addition to New Mountain, sponsoring investors in Validus include Aquiline Capital Partners, Goldman Sachs Capital Partners, Vestar Capital Partners, and Merrill Lynch Global Private Equity. In July 2007 Validus completed its initial public offering on the New York Stock Exchange and is traded under the symbol “VR”.

name: Vytalogy Wellness
description: Vytalogy Wellness and its family of brands, Natrol and Jarrow Formulas, is a modern wellness company that fuses science and quality ingredients to create highly-efficacious products that make a transformative impact on consumers’ lives. Founded in 1977, Jarrow Formulas is a leading independent formulator, manufacturer, and marketer of high-quality and scientifically supported probiotics, vitamins, minerals and supplements (“VMS”). The Company has a long heritage of producing innovative and efficacious formulations, having grown from a handful of products to hundreds of nutritional formulations, many of which were firsts for the dietary supplement industry. Jarrow’s goal to promote optimal health with high-quality, effective and affordable dietary supplements has cultivated an attractive, knowledgeable, loyal and global customer base. Founded in 1980, Natrol is the #1 brand for natural sleep and a leader in vital health areas including Sleep, Immunity, Brain Health, Mood & Stress and Beauty. The Company has provided high-quality and efficacious supplements to consumers across the globe for more than 40 years and has evolved into one of the most recognized and trusted brands in the VMS industry. New Mountain’s investment in Jarrow Formulas and Natrol is the result of the firm’s long-standing sector initiatives in consumer health & wellness (including VMS specifically), life sciences and food ingredients, as previously reflected by investments including Avantor, NuSil, Topix, Gelest, and Aceto.

name: Wipfli Advisory LLC (“Wipfli”)
description: Wipfli is a national advisory and accounting firm with a nearly 100-year legacy of serving ambitious middle-market organizations. Ranked among the top firms in the U.S., Wipfli is known for blending trusted relationships with bold ideas to help clients and communities thrive. With more than 3,000 associates, Wipfli delivers a full range of audit, tax and consulting solutions across industries and geographies — backed by global alliances and a modern approach to business advisory.

name: Zep Inc.
description: Zep is a leading manufacturer and marketer of a wide range of high-efficacy maintenance and cleaning solutions for commercial, industrial, institutional, and consumer end-markets under well-known and respected brand names. The breadth of the Zep product portfolio provides customized, superior cleaning and maintenance solutions to a broad customer base including manufacturers, food processors and preparers, restaurants, hospitals, schools, municipalities, government organizations, hotels and car washes. New Mountain identified Zep as part of its ongoing “deep dive” into the specialty chemicals and materials sector. As a result of this work, the firm had an ongoing relationship with a strong management team that worked closely with the deal team to conduct detailed due diligence and was able to acquire Zep outside of an auction process.
